# The CI legs branch protection requires on main, one check name per line.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for two consumers: the branch
# protection rule itself (required_status_checks.contexts, set through the API)
# and the supported-platform table in README.md (tools/gen_platform_table.py
# reads it and marks each leg required or not). Adding a leg to ci.yml does NOT
# require it; adding a name here does not create a leg.
#
# Names are the rendered job names from a completed run - a name that matches
# nothing is silently unenforced, so add one only from a leg that has reported.
#
# NO LEG IS EXCLUDED. The linux-arm64 leg's boundary pin is the failure top of
# a descending sweep at a stated resolution rather than a lattice draw of the
# oscillating error envelope: the draw spread 27.0% from the lattice alone on
# one machine, where the failure top spreads 5.1% across gcc/clang/MSVC. The
# leg is required here like the rest.

windows-msvc Release
windows-msvc Debug
linux-x86 gcc Release
linux-x86 gcc Debug
linux-x86 clang Release
linux-x86 clang Debug
linux-x86 clang-tidy
linux-sanitizers asan+ubsan
linux-arm64 gcc Release
windows-arm64 msvc Release
macos arm64
macos x64

# Every name above is a leg that has reported green at least once, which is
# the bar for adding one: a required
# name that never reports blocks every PR.
